lina-devex: Observed a parity bug: curl to /v1/embeddings?allow_partial=1 succeeds with partial vectors, JS SDK call with allowPartial throws 400.

omar-sdks: which SDK version? quick snippet?

lina-devex: v1.8.0.
```
# REST
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?allow_partial=1\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $T\" -d '{"model":"tiny-embed","inputs":["a","b"]}'
```
JS: 
```
client.embeddings.create({model:'tiny-embed', inputs:['a','b'], allowPartial:true})
```
REST 200 w/ partials; SDK 400 unknown param: allowPartial.

tess-api: server accepts snake_case query keys; SDK currently only maps body keys and then validates them strictly.

omar-sdks: easy fix: accept camelCase aliases and emit allow_partial in query for batch endpoints. Will add unit tests.

lina-devex: also noticed Retry behavior: server sends Retry-After on 429 but SDK used x-retry-after-ms only. Caused rapid retries in staging.

maya-samples: our onboarding quickstart CI failed because of this. If SDK retries too fast CI flaps.

omar-sdks: will change retry middleware to prefer Retry-After, fallback to x-retry-after-ms, and add deterministic backoff tests.

ci-bot: Branch opened: fix/sdk-allowpartial-retryheaders (#2783) by omar-sdks  CI queued.

lina-devex: thanks — can someone add a tiny sample smoke test that compares curl vs SDK shapes for embeddings/generate? would catch silent drift.

omar-sdks: yes, adding a lightweight shape-diff smoke test to samples/ci.

tess-api: we'll keep emitting both headers for a release window.

maya-samples: post-merge I'll bump quickstart and rerun CI.

lina-devex: great work, thanks!
